comment: Dr. G is a great professor for FYS100.

Great professor and has very easy content overall. Most classes are discussion based so if you read the material, try and contribute! She is also very nice and understanding and wants to help you. Also the lectures are quite funny and everything bolded is important for the midterm and final.

Prof. Giustiniano is a great history prof! Her lectures are clear & homework assignments aren't very hard. Exams are fair & if you pay attention during the semester, you'll only need to study a little bit. Expectations for projects and papers are clearly outlined & she gives ample time to complete them. She's so kind & cares about her students.

Dr G is new to teaching and a hidden gem. She made what could've been a boring subject really engaging and rewarding. Assignments are few, interesting, fun, and the two tests are graded fairly and easily. Especially recommend as a non history major for history elective credit. Don't let the 300 level scare you, Dr G is easy and cares about students
